title: Werfelstraße, Berlin
description:
🌟🏠 Your New Home Awaits at Werfelstraße! 🌼🏙️

Discover this beautiful 2-room flat on the 2nd floor at Werfelstraße, Berlin, fully furnished and ready for you to move in! 🛋️🍽️

The spacious bedroom offers comfort with a double bed, desk, chair, and ample closet space for your belongings. 🛏️💼 In the living room, unwind on a cozy sofa while enjoying entertainment on the TV or gather around the dining table for meals. 📺🍲

A fully equipped kitchen includes all essentials for cooking, alongside a convenient washing machine in the bathroom. 🍳🛁 Step onto the balcony to relax after a busy day, making this flat perfect for couples seeking a peaceful retreat. 🌿🌇

Located in Werfelstraße, this neighbourhood offers a blend of tranquillity and convenience. 🏡 Enjoy easy access to transportation with nearby tram and subway stops 🚋, ensuring seamless connectivity throughout Berlin. Explore local amenities including shops, cafes, and parks within walking distance for added comfort and convenience. 🛒☕

Make this excellent flat your new home and experience comfortable living in one of Berlin's vibrant neighbourhoods! 🌟

✔If you would like to bring a pet 🐾, please mention this in your application! 📝This will mean the deposit 💰 and cleaning fee 🧹 will increase. 
✔The broadcasting fee 📺 (GEZ) has to be carried by the tenant.
✔ The cleaning fee of 100 Euros has to be paid separately by the tenant to the landlord.

title: Cecilienstraße, Berlin
description:
This furnished maisonette apartment offers a rare combination of a private garden and additional flexible space in the souterrain, making it ideal for professionals, expats or temporary stays in Berlin.

The bright living room with direct access to the terrace opens up to the garden and creates a calm, green living atmosphere. The apartment also includes a separate bedroom, a fully equipped kitchen and a modern bathroom.

A spiral staircase leads to the souterrain level, which serves as an extension of the living space and can be used as a home office, guest area or hobby room. Following on from this, there is an additional room complemented by additional storage space. 

The apartment has been recently renovated; kitchen, bathroom, flooring and furniture are new and carefully coordinated. It is fully furnished and ready to move in.

The rental is fixed-term and particularly suitable for families or professionals who like the option of working from home.

Located in a quiet, green residential area in Berlin-Lichtenrade with good access to public transport, shopping facilities and the airport.

title: Karlstraße, Berlin
description:
English
Why live in the noisy center when you can have this?

🛏 Just bring your toothbrush – Fully furnished, move-in ready. A cosy bedroom with a wardrobe that swallows everything, a bright living room, and a proper desk workspace. Arrive with a suitcase, start living immediately.

🌿 Your own secret garden – Ground floor with a terrace that opens straight into your 120 m2 private garden. Hop on your bike and in 5 minutes you're in open fields and forest along the old Berlin Wall strip. Birdsong, not sirens.

⛺ Your winter retreat (or gym, or studio) – A 4×8 m weather-proof tent, usable all year. Want to do yoga in the fresh air? Paint? Build a second office away from your bedroom? This space does it all.

🚉 8 minutes to the train – 35 to Mitte – The S-Bahn is a short stroll away. In just over half an hour you're at the heart of Berlin. City life when you want it, peace when you don't.

🍳 Kitchen that actually works – Modern fitted kitchen with oven, dishwasher, fridge-freezer, and all the gadgets. Cook a proper meal, meal-prep for the week, or just make a really good coffee.

Deutsch
Wieso im lauten Zentrum wohnen, wenn du das haben kannst?

🛏 Koffer auspacken, wohlfühlen – Voll möbliert, sofort einziehbar. Ein gemütliches Schlafzimmer mit XXL-Kleiderschrank, ein helles Wohnzimmer und ein richtiger Schreibtisch-Arbeitsplatz. Ankommen und einfach leben.

🌿 Dein eigener Geheimgarten – Erdgeschoss-Wohnung mit Terrasse, die direkt in 120 m2 Privatgarten führt. Fünf Minuten Radweg und du bist auf freien Feldern und im Wald entlang des alten Mauerstreifens. Hier hörst du Vögel, keine Autos.

⛺ Winterzelt – deine zweite Bühne – Ein 4×8 m Winterzelt, wetterfest und ganzjährig nutzbar. Ob Yoga-Studio, Malwerkstatt oder Rückzugsort zum Arbeiten – dieser Raum macht alles mit.

🚉 8 Minuten zum Zug, 35 nach Mitte – Die S-Bahn Lichtenrade ist fußläufig erreichbar. In gut einer halben Stunde bist du im Herzen Berlins. Stadtleben, wann du willst. Ruhe, wann du sie brauchst.

🍳 Eine Küche, die dich verwöhnt – Moderne Einbauküche mit Backofen, Geschirrspüler, Kühl-Gefrier-Kombi und allem Drum und Dran. Ob Candle-Light-Dinner oder Vorbereiten für die Woche – hier macht Kochen richtig Spaß.
